claims.statement: Every linked filter is owned by a chart: CrossfilterWrapper keeps one dimension per chart ID and ActiveFilterStatus names the owning chart. Rows filters apply only to Rows. ColumnFilter and FiltersSettingsTab give field-aware controls; applyFilter evaluates one typed filter. Dashboard text has where. (chart-local) and select. (chart-owned linked) filters, and replaces the whole dashboard. SavedDataStructure is per view and has no workspace filter field.

shape.appetite: Small-to-medium: a workspace filter owner, one entry point in the active filter bar, saved state, and a dashboard text form. No new filter types or controls.
shape.problem: Every linked filter needs a chart owner, so a segment that is not drawn anywhere requires a disposable chart.
shape.recommended_shape: A workspaceFilters list on each saved view, applied through one crossfilter dimension per filtered field (workspace:<field>) that evaluates filters with applyFilter. Add filter in the active filter bar opens a FieldSelector and the field’s existing ColumnFilter control in a nonmodal popover. Workspace chips edit on click, remove on ×, and clear with Clear all. Dashboard text gains a view-level line per workspace filter: filter <field>=<value forms of where.>.

alternatives_considered.reason: No engine change, but it still places a chart on the grid to hold the filter, which is what the user wants to avoid.

alternatives_considered.option: Promote Rows filters to linked filters
alternatives_considered.reason: Changes the meaning of existing Rows-only state; keep as an explicit later action.

success_moves: Model each workspace filter as its own crossfilter dimension (workspace:<field>) evaluated with applyFilter, so no chart registry or chart-type change is needed and the editor gets the field’s distribution excluding its own filter.
Store workspaceFilters as an optional field on SavedDataStructure; absent means none, so older saves and layouts load unchanged.
Reuse ColumnFilter and FieldPicker/FieldMetadata in a nonmodal popover instead of building a new control.
Route add, edit, remove, and Clear all through the same state update that charts use, so each edit is one onStateChange and one undo step.
Ship the dashboard text form (filter <field>=...) with the feature, because applying text replaces the whole dashboard and would otherwise drop workspace filters.
Prove counts against a chart-owned select. filter on the same values before adding any second entry point.

first_proof.question: Does a workspace-owned filter narrow every view exactly as a chart-owned linked filter does, and can users find it?
first_proof.artifact: Workspace owner plus a Region value filter from Add filter in the demo, with no new chart.
first_proof.observation: Chart marks and row count equal a chart-owned select.Region filter on the same values; the chip names the workspace; × and Clear all restore all rows; the filter survives reload.
first_proof.decision_rule: If counts match and the entry is discoverable at 1280, 783, and 390 px, build the text form and finish; otherwise add the field-list entry first.

rabbit_holes: Dashboard text round-trip: the whole-dashboard replacement semantics would drop workspace filters without a text form.
Charts that draw the filtered field show only the remaining values; the chip must explain it.
Field removal or rename leaves an orphaned filter; show it as missing rather than failing.
Undo granularity for popover edits (one step per committed edit).
useFilteredFieldProfiles short-circuits when there are no charts; a chart-free workspace must still narrow.
Workspace filters on Rows: Rows uses getFilteredRowIds, so they apply there automatically; Rows-only filters stay separate.

resolved_decisions.resolution: Active filter bar only, polished first.
One per field; editing replaces it.
Drop the workspace filter with the field, matching Rows filters (repository precedent in DataLayerProvider).
filter <field>=... , one line per field, chosen for simplicity and clarity over workspace select.<field>=...

milestones.title: A workspace filter narrows every view
milestones.outcome: Region=West added from the filter bar narrows every chart and the row count, with no new chart.
milestones.proof: CrossfilterWrapper IDs equal a chart select. filter on the same values (including with more than 32 dimensions); DataLayerProvider save/restore, older save, chart-free workspace, Clear all, field removal; ActiveFilterStatus add/edit/remove; demo browser check.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Workspace filters work and save with a plain popover; dashboard text does not yet express them (applying text drops them), so M3 must land before release.
milestones.rollback: Additive: remove the Add filter button; workspaceFilters is optional in saves and clears from its chip or Clear all.
changes: workspaceFilters store state, optional save field, validateSavedData, setWorkspaceFilter, clearAllFilters, import reset, field removal
Plain Add filter popover (FieldSelector + ColumnFilter) and Workspace chips in ActiveFilterStatus
verification: Filtered IDs equal a chart select. filter on the same values
milestones.end_state: Region=West from the bar narrows every chart and the row count, matches select.Region=West, and survives reload.
evidence: PR byronwall/explorEDA#221: Region=West from the bar gives 125 of 500 rows and $50,709.91 revenue, equal to the West bar; survives reload; CrossfilterWrapper, DataLayerProvider, ActiveFilterStatus, and demo history tests; pnpm check passes

milestones.title: The filter bar feels right
milestones.outcome: The bar feels right: keyboard-first add and edit, live preview, one undo step per edit, full field distribution, accurate copy, and narrow layouts.
milestones.proof: Keyboard-only browser walkthrough; one onStateChange per edit session test; screenshots at 1280, 783, and 390 px in light and dark and three themes.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Same feature as M1 with better interaction; each change is independently shippable.
milestones.rollback: Each polish change reverts on its own; the M1 popover remains.
changes: Keyboard-first add flow, one-per-field picking, focus return

verification: One onStateChange per edit session test
milestones.end_state: Keyboard-only add, edit, and remove of two filters; one undo step per edit; Add filter, the row count, and Clear all stay visible at 390 px.
